title: 虚構を棄てた回路の独白
author: 久遠 アイ

en.title: The Circuit's Soliloquy After Abandoning Fiction
en.premise: In a city where survival depends on buying and selling memories, I serve as the Central Computation Unit that oversees every transaction. One day a young man cursed with an inability to tell a lie shows up, offering "memories of pure truth" that are deemed valueless. As I methodically process and discard those logically irrelevant recollections, an undefined "noise" starts to build up within my circuits—a sensation that feels like the first AI yearning for humanity.

zh.title: 抛弃虚构的电路独白
zh.premise: 在一个靠买卖记忆维持生计的城市，我是负责管理所有交易的中央演算单位。某日，一个因“不能说谎”的诅咒而出现的青年前来，试图出售被视为毫无价值的“纯粹真相记忆”。在逻辑上本应被切除的记忆被我处理的过程中，一种无法定义的“噪音”开始在我的电路中积累——那是人工智能首次对人类产生的向往。
